ABOUT ATOMIC

Good ideas deserve
a way forward.

We’re building Atomic for the moment you know what your business needs—and want to make it real.

Useful software starts
with your world.

A studio that needs a better way to take bookings. A small brand ready for its first shop. A team that wants to keep clients in the loop. The people closest to a business often know exactly what would make it work better.

Atomic gives those ideas a place to take shape: describe the app, refine it in conversation, review the result, and prepare it for the people who will use it.

THE TEAM BEHIND THE PRODUCT

Built by
Abstract Machines.

Atomic is a product of Abstract Machines, an open-source infrastructure company based in Paris. The team’s work spans identity, messaging, connected systems, and edge computing.

Meet Abstract Machines ↗
01 / THE FOUNDATION

We build the layers underneath.

The same company develops Atom, the open-source identity and authorization foundation used by Atomic.

What matters to us.

01 / USEFULNESS

Start with a real task.

A good app helps someone do something that matters. We start with the workflow and shape the experience around it.

02 / VISIBILITY

Understand what you build.

Previews, source access, and clear product boundaries help you review your app and make informed decisions.

03 / CONTROL

Keep a hand in the process.

Describe the direction, inspect the result, and choose what to publish. Your judgment belongs in every step.
